readings.commitment: The 1791 Constitution opens with the Declaration: rights of man and citizen declared universal in August 1789 and prefixed to the text as its reason for existing
readings.delta: Suppression of the old order's legal premises wholesale; beneficiary is the rights-bearing citizen in the abstract; victim set is privilege by birth and order; extractiveness of feudal dues declared void

readings.commitment: The 1791 Constitution split the citizen in two: active citizens with the tax-qualified vote, passive citizens with rights but no political voice — universality means-tested at the ballot
readings.delta: Suppression of the propertyless from the franchise the Declaration implied; beneficiary is the tax-paying electorate; victim set is passive citizens, servants, and all women; extractiveness of political power indexed to direct taxation

readings.commitment: The 1791 Constitution kept the king as a magistrate: hereditary head of the executive with a suspensive veto only — monarchy retained, demoted, and chained
readings.delta: Suppression of absolute kingship to delaying power; beneficiary is the legislature's primacy; victim set is royal sovereignty doctrine; extractiveness of the veto reduced to two legislatures' delay

readings.commitment: The 1791 Constitution lasted under a year: war, the flight to Varennes, and the insurrection of August 1792 destroyed it — the constitution as the Revolution's discarded first draft
readings.delta: Suppression of the constitutional-monarchy compromise by events; beneficiary is the republic that followed; victim set is the settlement's adherents on both sides; extractiveness of the failure instructive to every successor text

readings.commitment: The Declaration speaks for mankind: rights of man, not of Frenchmen — the first constitutional text addressed past its own borders to every people
readings.delta: Suppression of particularist rights traditions; beneficiary is universalism and every later importer; victim set is rights-of-Englishmen historicism; extractiveness of legitimacy claims globalized

readings.commitment: The Declaration is property's charter: sacred and inviolable in Article 17, the document of a propertied revolution securing its gains in universal language
readings.delta: Suppression of redistribution claims at the founding; beneficiary is acquiring third-estate wealth; victim set is the propertyless reading Article 1 literally; extractiveness of the social question deferred behind sacred property

readings.commitment: The Declaration declared and could not enforce: no court, no remedy, no review — principles floating above a constitution that violated them at the franchise
readings.delta: Suppression of enforcement by omission; beneficiary is the principles' rhetorical career; victim set is claimants with no forum; extractiveness of the gap between declared and delivered

readings.commitment: The active-citizen franchise had a theory: only the independent can vote independently, and the tax threshold measured the stake that made judgment free
readings.delta: Suppression of dependent voters by stake doctrine; beneficiary is propertied deliberation theory; victim set is wage-dependent citizens; extractiveness of the vote priced at three days' labor in tax

readings.commitment: The split betrayed the Declaration in its second year: equal rights of man, unequal rights of citizens — the Revolution's own measure of how far it would not go
readings.delta: Suppression of the universalism just proclaimed; beneficiary is the censitary electorate; victim set is the passive millions; extractiveness of political voice withheld from the taxed-but-poor

readings.commitment: Both categories excluded women entirely: de Gouges answered with the Rights of Woman and went to the guillotine — the exclusion contemporaries named and the Constitution kept
readings.delta: Suppression of half the nation from both citizen classes; beneficiary is the male monopoly on the political; victim set is women as named by their own pamphlets; extractiveness of civic existence denied by sex

readings.commitment: The suspensive veto was a serious design: an executive with delay but not denial, forcing reconsideration without permitting absolutism — Montesquieu operationalized
readings.delta: Suppression of both absolutism and assembly omnipotence; beneficiary is bicameral-style deliberation in time; victim set is winner-take-all sovereignty either way; extractiveness of rash legislation slowed

readings.commitment: Varennes emptied the design: a king who fled toward foreign armies could veto nothing legitimately — the constitution kept a head of state its people had stopped believing
readings.delta: Suppression of the king's credit, not his office; beneficiary is republican argument; victim set is the constitutional-monarchist center; extractiveness of every later veto read as treason's instrument

readings.commitment: The veto plus war equaled paralysis: refusals on émigrés and priests at the worst hour made the suspensive veto the insurrection's recruiting sergeant
readings.delta: Suppression of emergency legislation at the emergency's peak; beneficiary is the veto-wielding court in the short run; victim set is the settlement itself in the only run that mattered; extractiveness of deadlock paid at the Tuileries

readings.commitment: War killed the 1791 settlement: the declaration of April 1792 made every internal compromise a security question and the king a suspected enemy commander
readings.delta: Suppression of constitutional time by military time; beneficiary is emergency logic and its practitioners; victim set is gradualist settlement; extractiveness of crisis consuming the institutions built for peace

readings.commitment: The settlement died of its own contradictions: a sovereign nation with an unaccountable hereditary executive, universal rights with a censitary franchise — collapse was the design resolving itself
readings.delta: Suppression of incoherence by rupture; beneficiary is whichever principle won (popular sovereignty); victim set is the both-and compromise; extractiveness of the contradiction paid by the document

readings.commitment: The 1791 text founded a series: the first of France's fifteen-odd constitutions, establishing that in France the constitution is an episode of the regime, not its container
readings.delta: Suppression of constitutional permanence as a French expectation; beneficiary is each regime's fresh text; victim set is settlement-duration constitutionalism; extractiveness of foundings repeated at each regime's price
